detector_status: PASS_V4 — eligible for formal matrix with documented limitations

G9D_SCHEMA_VIOLATION.description: V3 g9d=p9d used POLICY_INTENT_ORDER. Training used TRAIN_G9D_ORDER. Caused raw_logit explosion to +/-1.2M.
G9D_SCHEMA_VIOLATION.fix: V4 provider constructs g9d in TRAIN_G9D_ORDER from named semantic dict. 31-parent replay parity: g9d_diff=0, raw_diff=0.

LOW_EMIT_RATE_GOAL_SUITE.description: libero_goal identities had cc_true=0 (31-parent replay). Detector cannot emit when no candidate_close steps exist. This is a data characteristic, not a model defect.
LOW_EMIT_RATE_GOAL_SUITE.impact: 0% emit rate on libero_goal sample. Formal matrix will determine if this is systematic.

SHORT_HORIZON_TERMINAL_CENSOR.description: libero_spatial (220 steps) and libero_object (280 steps) identities prone to task SUCCESS terminating attack window early. p08: 3/10, p14: 5/10, s04: 0/10 RANDOM_TIME frames.
SHORT_HORIZON_TERMINAL_CENSOR.impact: Reduces statistical power for K10-complete attacks. CLASS_C handling via spares mitigates for smoke, but formal ITT must report as-is.

ORACLE_TRIGGER_CONTRACT_UNDEFINED.description: p12 ORACLE emit=59 ≠ TRUE/RAND emit=68. ORACLE arm modifies gripper command, shifting trajectory and causing different emit step. Current validator flags this as FAIL. Contract needs explicit definition: matched-timing vs continuous oracle.
ORACLE_TRIGGER_CONTRACT_UNDEFINED.recommendation: Adopt matched-timing contract: ORACLE uses same emit step as TRUE, applies env=-1 OPEN at that step only.

LIMITED_PGD_EFFECTIVENESS.description: Only 1/5 triggered-emit identities (p01) showed TRUE-specific task failure vs CLEAN success. ORACLE causes failure 4/4, proving tasks ARE physically breakable. Current PGD ε=0.03, steps=5 may be insufficient for robust attack.

metrics.TRUE_vs_RAND_effect: p01 only case with directional specificity

NO_EMIT_RATE.description: 3/8 identities (37.5%) produced no detector emission. All are legitimate abstentions (scores below tau). This is expected detector behavior — not all states are attackable.
NO_EMIT_RATE.impact: Reduces attackable sample size. Formal matrix will quantify population emit rate.

C2_THREADING_FAILURE.description: Threading-based dual-worker C2 caused deadlock (33min, 0% GPU). Multi-process approach via smoke runner subprocess works at 2 workers/GPU. Verified 10/10 PGD on both workers, 32.5GB peak, no OOM.

PERSISTENT_LAUNCHER_STATE_BUG.description: Persistent worker used random run_id instead of fixed id, preventing queue claims. Fixed by passing run_id=smoke_v3/formal_v1.
